note: Growth phase: one text per level in 'levels' every morning, until there are 'slow.after' daily texts in total (all reading/YYYY-MM-DD.json files together; the library and the solar terms don't count). After that, 'slow' applies.

slow.rule: From then on: 2 texts a day, both at ONE level. The level rotates through 'levels': take the level whose most recent daily text is the oldest (if tied, the lower level). The two texts take different angles on today's theme and different kinds (e.g. one story or dialogue, one feature).

settings: Readers live in many countries (Germany, Brazil, the UK, the US and elsewhere) and choose English, German or Portuguese as their helper language. Over a week, about half the texts may be set in Germany or involve life in Germany; the rest are set in Chinese-speaking places (mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore), in other countries readers come from (Brazil, the UK, the US …), or are universal. Never assume the reader lives in Germany; when a text compares with 'home', keep it open or vary the country.

themes.Mon: 城市生活 City life (transport, neighbourhoods, cafés, markets, housing, life in Germany and in Chinese cities)
themes.Tue: 饮食 Food and drink (dishes, trends, tea, cooking, eating out, regional food)
themes.Wed: 网络与流行语 Internet trends and slang (new words, memes, online habits; explain what they mean and how they are used)
themes.Thu: 学习与工作 Study and work (school, university, office life, languages, side jobs)
themes.Fri: 休闲与爱好 Free time (sport, music, film and series, games, travel, weekends)
themes.Sat: 文化与节日 Culture and customs (festivals, traditions, idioms and their stories, everyday etiquette)
themes.Sun: 自然与生活方式 Nature and lifestyle (seasons, pets, health habits without medical claims, slow living)

avoid: politics, governments, elections, war, crime, religion, medical claims, money advice, real named private people, brand controversies, anything sensitive about any country
